svg.title: A read-only share link for an epic or a saved view — SoftTrack web design mockup (#245)
svg.desc: A team admin creates a link for an epic or a saved view, and whoever has it sees a read-only page without signing in: each ticket’s key, title, status and type, with the epic’s progress and target date. Comments, attachments, assignees and estimates are left out unless the link turns them on, and internal notes are never shown.

svg.text: Done when a team admin can create, list and revoke share links for an epic or a saved view, the page needs no sign-in and shows key, title, status, type, progress and target date,
the rest is off by default and chosen per link, only the token’s hash is stored, a link can expire and ask for a password, the page sends noindex and is rate limited, and every
change to a link is recorded.
